description: Verifiable random bytes for a draw, raffle or tie-break: an ECVRF output over your seed plus a proof anyone can check offline. The same seed always gives the same output, so publish the seed first to show the result was not picked. Costs $0.006 per call. The first 5 priced calls per caller are free.

seed.description: Seed or message the draw is bound to.
